answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 6142 Country: Pakistan Title: I am a convert sunni from dawoodi bohra (I have kept this as secret) but my wife is dawoodi bohri. Please tell me whether my marriage is ok or not! and what shall I do. Question: Dear Brother salam-u-alaykoom I am a convert sunni from dawoodi bohra (I have kept this as secret) but my wife is dawoodi bohri. Please tell me whether my marriage is ok or not! and what shall I do. Answer ID: 6142 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1256/1061=B-1429) The marriage to remain intact or to end depends on your wife whether she embraces Islam or not. You should contact reliable Ulama of Pakistan like Hadhrat Maulana Muhammad Taqi Usmani sahib; they will tell you the right thing along with the procedure. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
